key_evidence.claim: Strong linear decodability under the headline protocol
Readable layers differ from perturbation-sensitive layers

key_evidence.claim: Known initial conditions are linearly readable from full videos
key_evidence.numbers: x0 R² approximately 1; v0 WAN 0.88, wider models approximately 0.99

reproduction_risks.issue: Noise hook also covers scoring inversion in public implementation
reproduction_risks.evidence: intervention.py lines 222–223 enter noise_intervention around generate_and_score. generate_and_score (lines 208–213) calls both pipeline generation and probe_surprise. probe_surprise reinverts through the same pipeline (lines 153–170); hook removed only at context exit (lines 129–133). models/wan_inversion.py uses pipeline.transformer.
reproduction_risks.consequence: Public default surprise shift mixes generation changes with direct perturbation of measurement features. Static control-flow finding; no assertion that paper Figure 5 was produced by this exact code or that numerical impact has been measured.
reproduction_risks.proposed_check: End intervention hook before reinversion scoring; add generation-only, scoring-only, both and neither controls, then verify external physical metrics.

reproduction_risks.issue: Paper and executable default probe configurations differ
reproduction_risks.code: CLI default20% validation, batch32; README examples supply seeds0,1,2,3,4 and do not override val-split or batch-size.
reproduction_risks.positive_control: Code groups videos by scenario before splitting, keeping plausible/implausible variants on the same side.
reproduction_risks.consequence: README default commands cannot be asserted to reproduce the published protocol; use explicit configuration and saved split manifest.

reproduction_risks.issue: Heun has greater network-evaluation cost than Euler
reproduction_risks.evidence: models/integrators.py computes a second prediction at Euler-proposed state for every Heun step except the last. Euler needs one prediction per step.
reproduction_risks.consequence: Paper Section 3.1 one-evaluation description applies to its displayed Euler approximation; equal step counts are not equal NFE.

reproduction_risks.issue: README frame examples differ from Appendix F
reproduction_risks.consequence: Actual model-specific frame normalization and published run settings need verification; do not silently substitute README counts for paper protocol.

interpretive_boundaries: Chance linear probing of VAE latents is not absence of physical information in the latent representation.
Linear readout of full-video initial conditions does not establish explicit physical laws or causal future prediction.
Noise interventions evaluate a learned probe proxy; generic image degradation and measurement contamination require controls.
Three-backbone width correlation is confounded with training data, architecture and autoencoder; it is not a controlled scaling law.
No PDF mirror; paper and code licenses have different scopes.
